messages:
Jordan: quick follow-up from the postmortem: recurring OOMs on inference-workers stemming from slow per-shard resident growth + fragmentation. want to lock owners and short-term mitigations.

Jordan: proposed actions (callouts, please :thumbsup: or claim):
  A) lightweight continuous heap sampling + periodic jemalloc stats capture (owner?) ETA 72h
  B) per-shard soft caps + eviction policy for long-lived shards (owner?) ETA 5d
  C) investigate arena/tcache usage and fragmentation patterns; recommend malloc_conf tweaks (owner?) ETA 10d
  D) add an observable "memory drift" graph and a sustained-growth alert (owner?) ETA 3d
  E) update oncall runbook with repro steps and mitigation playbook (owner?) ETA 4d

Priya: I'll take A. I'll run pprof snapshots every 5m for a set of problematic pods and collect jemalloc stats. will upload to INF-1458 and post a short summary.

Sam: I'll pick B and C. plan: implement a soft cap that kicks an LRU eviction when a shard exceeds its working set for >15m, and prototype malloc_conf tuning in canary. ETA next Fri for canary.

Jordan: thanks. Priya, can you paste the minimal commands you plan to use so infra can wire a scheduled job?

Priya: sure, here's the gist (full script in the ticket):
```
# sample heap and jemalloc info every 5m
PODS=$(kubectl get pods -l app=infer -o jsonpath='{.items[*].metadata.name}')
for p in $PODS; do
  kubectl exec $p -- sh -c "pprof -raw /proc/self/exe /tmp/heap.$(date +%s).pprof" || true
  kubectl exec $p -- sh -c "jemalloc-config --stats" > /tmp/jemalloc.$p.$(date +%s).txt || true
done
```
I'll attach the scheduled job once infra-bot creates it.

oncall-bot: scheduled job JOB-981 created to collect heap samples across canaries. next run in 4m.

Sam: noted re: malloc_conf. we'll gate changes behind feature flags and only roll to dedicated pools first. also adding a microbenchmark that creates long-lived session churn to surface fragmentation quickly.

Jordan: for the soft cap, ensure the eviction policy supports "non-blocking fallback" so inference loops don't stall. also include metrics for evictions per shard.

Sam: yep. eviction will be background-only; requests will trigger metrics but not block. will add a counter and histogram for eviction latency.

Jordan: Liaise with SRE to make the new drift alert page (severity=P1 if sustained >100MB over 6h) and a lower severity warning earlier.

Sam: tagging SRE in the ticket.

ops-bot: created ticket INF-1458 "kv-cache memory drift + mitigation". assignees: Priya, Sam, Jordan.

Priya: quick finding from first pass: some shards show steady +20-40MB/day growth correlated with LRU metadata not expiring correctly after warmup. if this is reproducible we can ship a TTL enforcement hotfix in a day.

Jordan: if TTL mismatch is the cause, hotfix + canary is preferred. Sam, can your eviction soft cap be a stop-gap while we validate the TTL fix?

Sam: yes, eviction cap can be tuned conservatively and rolled to canary immediately. will coordinate with Priya for telemetry hooks.

Jordan: plan recap and checkpoints: Priya (sampling + upload) ETA 72h; Sam (eviction + malloc_conf pilot + microbench) ETA 5d for initial canary; Jordan (alerts + runbook update) ETA 4d. sync in 5 days to review numbers.

Priya: uploading initial pprof + jemalloc dumps to INF-1458 now.

Jordan: thanks all. please update INF-1458 with PR links and mark sub-tasks as done when complete. scheduling a 30m sync in 5 days. :white_check_mark:
